# SoundEvents

**Tags:** `world-system`

The sound event table: gameplay plays an event id, which names the asset key, the audio bus, whether it is positional, how many variants it picks from, its base volume and its pitch jitter. Files live under `assets/sounds/` as `.ogg.raw`, with a generated placeholder for every key.

> **Goal:** Sounds are data: a new sound is a row and a file, never a path in gameplay code (Phase 275)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `buses` | json | yes | The audio buses under Master, in layout order |
| `events` | json | yes | { <event id>: { key, bus, spatial: 2d\|3d, variants, volumeDb, pitchJitter, loop, maxDistance? } } |
| `files` | json | yes | { <event id>: [asset keys] } — `<key>.ogg.raw`, or `<key>_01.ogg.raw`.. for sfx variants |
